integrity: The conclusion is obtained by retaining the Stein-factor degree and the degree of the canonical image in the source's proof chain. Equality forces every intermediate degree inequality to be sharp. No finite experiment or external certification is used.
scientific_limitations: Smooth projective complex threefolds with kappa=1, pg>=2, and equality in the Chen--Hu--Jiang--Liu Iitaka-volume bound; no classification of fibers or moduli is claimed, and pg=1 is excluded.
title: Equality in the Kodaira-dimension-one Noether bound forces a rational-normal canonical base
